themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Multiple right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies in response to recent border crises. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, Norway, the UK, and France, where parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Fremskrittspartiet, Reform UK, and Rassemblement National are advocating for stricter border controls, deportations, and opposition to migrant resettlement programs.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes government for handling of unaccompanied migrant minors and demands stricter border controls in Ceuta and Melilla.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government maintains Schengen suspension over migration disputes with Spain, focusing on border security and deportations.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Criticizes government's handling of migration issues, particularly in relation to Ceuta and broader immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes banning foreign nationals from receiving benefits and advocates for stricter immigration controls.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Continues to push for stricter immigration policies and border controls as a central part of their platform.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant electoral gains across Europe, particularly in Germany, Sweden, France, Spain, and Norway. This trend is marked by rising poll numbers, internal party conflicts, and debates over leadership and strategy as these parties position themselves for upcoming elections.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and faces internal debates about extremism and leadership ahead of state elections.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Continues to gain influence in Swedish politics, with debates about their role in government and policy positions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Expands voter base and prepares for 2027 presidential elections, with Jordan Bardella emerging as a key figure.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Faces internal divisions but remains a significant force in Spanish regional politics, particularly in Andalusia and Madrid.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Gains traction in Norwegian politics with a focus on climate policy and local governance issues.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in the UK, Argentina, Norway, and Poland are implementing or proposing significant cuts to social programs as part of broader fiscal debates. These policies often target welfare benefits, disability support, and public services, sparking public backlash and political controversy.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes drastic cuts to welfare programs, including disability benefits, and mandatory community work for long-term claimants.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Implements austerity measures, including cuts to public services and social programs, as part of economic reforms.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates for reduced public spending and questions the sustainability of current welfare programs.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes government's handling of fiscal policies, including fuel taxes and social program funding.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal party divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Across multiple countries, right-wing and far-right parties are experiencing significant internal divisions and leadership challenges. These conflicts often revolve around policy directions, electoral strategies, and personal rivalries, threatening party unity and electoral prospects.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Faces internal divisions over strategy, alliances, and leadership, with former PM Morawiecki forming a new party.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega faces leadership crisis with calls for Salvini's resignation and internal debates about party direction.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Experiences internal rifts and leadership challenges, particularly around Nigel Farage's role and financial controversies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Faces internal divisions and defections, particularly in Madrid, over party direction and leadership.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Experiences tensions with potential allies like PRO over electoral strategies and policy compromises.

themes.title: Trump administration targets gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ rights
themes.blurb: The Trump administration in the United States is implementing policies that target gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ rights, with parallel actions seen in Poland, the UK, and Spain. These policies include restrictions on healthcare, legal challenges, and cultural rhetoric that often frames LGBTQ+ issues as threats to traditional values.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Implements policies restricting gender-affirming care, reduces recommended childhood vaccines, and faces lawsuits over LGBTQ+ rights.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Continues to promote traditional values and opposes LGBTQ+ rights, with rhetoric linking these issues to national identity.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes gender policies in schools and public institutions, framing them as threats to traditional values.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Opposes LGBTQ+ rights and gender policies, particularly in education and public institutions, framing them as ideological impositions.
